description: S is replaced by n - S (n the P-256 group order), the high-S twin of a valid signature. The ECDSA verification equation holds for S and for n - S alike, so both verify unless a verifier adds a low-S rule, and neither RFC 7518 section 3.4 nor the draft states one. This vector records that current behaviour: accept. Whether a PACT verifier must reject high-S signatures is an open question for the draft; if the draft decides to reject them, this vector changes to reject.
